# Exact source and configuration appendix: Hgg

This is a lossless snapshot of the listed code/configuration files, not a list of stages to run. The human README identifies the accepted path. Older implementations included here can be dependencies of current adapters. Mathematical result payloads, large imported datasets, caches and external binaries are not embedded. Each block records its byte count, hash, mode and file or symlink kind. See the main README_code for reconstruction.

## Hgg/s01_result/reference/s01_result/s01_inputs/s01_amplitudes.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-2", "appendix": "Hgg/README_sources.md", "bytes": 2258, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "Hgg/s01_result/reference/s01_result/s01_inputs/s01_amplitudes.wls", "sha256": "c708d0fb865e69d106aac475efab4ea97594d50626a46fec2adc3ffb03239188"} -->
```wolfram
$HistoryLength = 0;
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False;
$LoadAddOns = {"FeynArts"};
Get["FeynCalc`"];
SetDirectory[DirectoryName[$InputFileName]];
If[!DirectoryQ["s01_result"], CreateDirectory["s01_result"]];
require[condition_, message_] := If[!TrueQ[condition], Print["FAIL: ", message]; Quit[1]];

generate[name_, incoming_, outgoing_, momentaIn_, momentaOut_] := Module[{graphs, raw, amps},
  Print["Generating ", name];
  graphs = InsertFields[CreateTopologies[0, Length[incoming] -> Length[outgoing]],
    incoming -> outgoing, Model -> "SMQCD", InsertionLevel -> {Particles}];
  raw = CreateFeynAmp[graphs, Truncated -> False, PreFactor -> 1];
  amps = FCFAConvert[raw, IncomingMomenta -> momentaIn, OutgoingMomenta -> momentaOut,
    UndoChiralSplittings -> True, ChangeDimension -> D, List -> True, SMP -> True,
    Contract -> False, DropSumOver -> True,
    FinalSubstitutions -> {SMP["m_u"] -> 0, SMP["m_d"] -> 0,
      SMP["e"] -> ee, SMP["g_s"] -> gs}] /. {GaugeXi[_] -> 1, MQU[_] -> 0, MQD[_] -> 0};
  (* The SM up-quark charge is replaced by a symbolic charge at amplitude level. *)
  amps = amps /. ee -> ee eq/(2/3);
  require[Length[amps] > 0 && FreeQ[amps, _FCFAConvert], name <> " generation"];
  Put[<|"graphs" -> graphs, "raw" -> raw, "amplitudes" -> amps,
    "incoming" -> momentaIn, "outgoing" -> momentaOut|>, "s01_result/" <> name <> ".wl"];
  Print[name, ": ", Length[amps], " diagrams; ", ByteCount[amps], " bytes"];
  Length[amps]
];

outcome = MemoryConstrained[
  <|"real" -> generate["real", {V[1], V[5]}, {V[5], F[3, {1}], -F[3, {1}]},
       {q, p}, {k1, k2, k3}],
    "born_qg" -> generate["born_qg", {V[1], F[3, {1}]}, {V[5], F[3, {1}]},
       {q, p}, {k1, k2}],
    "born_gq" -> generate["born_gq", {V[1], V[5]}, {F[3, {1}], -F[3, {1}]},
       {q, p}, {k1, k2}]|>, 4*1024^3, $Aborted];
require[outcome =!= $Aborted, "memory limit"];
Put[<|"diagram_counts" -> outcome, "wolfram" -> $Version,
  "feyncalc" -> $FeynCalcVersion, "channel" -> "gamma* g -> g q qbar",
  "charge" -> "one massless flavour with symbolic charge eq",
  "photon_coupling" -> "divide the squared amplitude by ee^2 for the current tensor",
  "dimension" -> HoldForm[4 - 2 eps]|>, "s01_result/manifest.wl"];
Print["PASS: amplitudes saved"];
Quit[0];

```
<!-- END SOURCE -->

## Hgg/s01_result/reference/s01_result/s01_inputs/s02_square.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-3", "appendix": "Hgg/README_sources.md", "bytes": 4159, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "Hgg/s01_result/reference/s01_result/s01_inputs/s02_square.wls", "sha256": "36e2344d20a9d07b48e0a79d86a9f4a92098770643683ffa8874c63b62c5d12c"} -->
```wolfram
$HistoryLength = 0;
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False;
Get["FeynCalc`"];
SetDirectory[DirectoryName[$InputFileName]];
If[!DirectoryQ["s02_result"], CreateDirectory["s02_result"]];
require[c_, m_] := If[!TrueQ[c], Print["FAIL: ", m]; Quit[1]];

(* Solve scalar products from the on-shell and Mandelstam definitions. *)
setKinematics[real_] := Module[{basis, gram, vars, dot, remaining, definitions, sol, all},
  FCClearScalarProducts[];
  basis = If[real, {p, q, k1, k2}, {p, q, k1}];
  gram = Table[sv[Min[i,j], Max[i,j]], {i,Length[basis]}, {j,Length[basis]}];
  vars = DeleteDuplicates[Flatten[gram]];
  dot[l_,r_] := (Coefficient[Expand[l],#]& /@ basis).gram.(Coefficient[Expand[r],#]& /@ basis);
  remaining = p + q - Total[Drop[basis,2]];
  definitions = Join[Thread[Diagonal[gram] == If[real,{0,-Q2,0,0},{0,-Q2,0}]],
    {dot[remaining,remaining] == 0, dot[p+q,p+q] == s,
     dot[q-k1,q-k1] == t},
    If[real, {dot[p-k1,p-k1] == w-Q2-s-t, dot[p-k2,p-k2] == a,
      dot[k1+k2,k1+k2] == b}, {}]];
  sol = Solve[definitions, vars];
  require[Length[sol] == 1, "unique kinematics"];
  sol = First[sol];
  all = If[real, {p,q,k1,k2,k3}, {p,q,k1,k2}];
  Do[With[{l=all[[i]], r=all[[j]], v=Factor[dot[
       all[[i]] /. Last[all] -> remaining,
       all[[j]] /. Last[all] -> remaining] /. sol]}, SPD[l,r] = v],
    {i,Length[all]}, {j,i,Length[all]}];
  If[real,
    Put[<|"u" -> ExpandScalarProduct[SPD[p-k1]],
      "forms" -> (Factor[ExpandScalarProduct[SPD[#]]]& /@
        {p-k2,p-k3,k1+k2,k1+k3,q-k2,q-k3}),
      "gram" -> Table[SPD[all[[i]],all[[j]]],{i,Length[all]},{j,Length[all]}],
      "momenta" -> all|>, "s02_result/kinematics.wl"]];
];

openPhoton[amp_, index_] := amp /. Momentum[Polarization[q,___],D] :> LorentzIndex[index,D];
reduce[amp_, channel_, projection_] := Module[{v, density, norm},
  density = Switch[projection, "g", MTD[mu,nu], "pp", FVD[p,mu] FVD[p,nu],
    "qq", FVD[q,mu] FVD[q,nu]];
  norm = If[channel == "born_qg", 2 SUNN, (D-2)(SUNN^2-1)];
  v = amp FCI[density]/norm;
  v = FeynAmpDenominatorExplicit[v];
  v = SUNSimplify[v, Explicit -> True, SUNNToCACF -> True];
  v = FermionSpinSum[v];
  If[channel != "born_qg", v = DoPolarizationSums[v,p,k1]];
  If[channel != "born_gq", v = DoPolarizationSums[v,k1,p]];
  v = DiracSimplify[v, DiracTraceEvaluate -> True];
  v = ExpandScalarProduct[Contract[v]];
  v = SUNSimplify[v, Explicit -> True, SUNNToCACF -> True];
  v = Factor[Together[v/ee^2 /. {SUNN -> Nc, CA -> Nc, CF -> (Nc^2-1)/(2 Nc)}]];
  require[FreeQ[v, _Spinor|_DiracGamma|_DiracTrace|_SUNTF|_SUNF|_SUNDelta|
     _LorentzIndex|_Polarization|_FeynAmpDenominator|_Pair], "scalar reduction"];
  v
];

Do[
  setKinematics[channel == "real"];
  amps = Get["s01_result/" <> channel <> ".wl"]["amplitudes"];
  pairs = Flatten[Table[{i,j},{i,Length[amps]},{j,i,Length[amps]}],1];
  Do[
    {i,j} = pair;
    file = "s02_result/" <> channel <> "_" <> IntegerString[i,10,2] <> IntegerString[j,10,2] <> ".wl";
    If[FileExistsQ[file], Print["Resume ", file]; Continue[]];
    tensor = openPhoton[amps[[i]],mu] ComplexConjugate[openPhoton[amps[[j]],nu], FCRenameDummyIndices -> True];
    If[i != j, tensor += openPhoton[amps[[j]],mu] ComplexConjugate[openPhoton[amps[[i]],nu], FCRenameDummyIndices -> True]];
    Print["Reducing ", channel, " ", pair];
    result = Association@Table[projection -> MemoryConstrained[reduce[tensor,channel,projection],
      4*1024^3,$Aborted], {projection,{"g","pp","qq"}}];
    require[FreeQ[result,$Aborted], "memory limit"];
    Put[result,file];
    Print["Saved ", channel," ",pair,"; bytes ",ByteCount[result],"; memory MB ",Round[MemoryInUse[]/1024^2]];
    Clear[tensor,result]; ClearSystemCache[],
    {pair,pairs}];
  result = Association@Table[projection -> Factor[Together[Total[
    Get[#][projection]& /@ FileNames[channel <> "_*.wl","s02_result"]]]],
    {projection,{"g","pp","qq"}}];
  require[result["qq"] === 0, channel <> " photon Ward identity"];
  Put[result,"s02_result/" <> channel <> ".wl"];
  Print["PASS: ",channel," scalar square and photon Ward identity"],
  {channel,{"born_qg","born_gq","real"}}];
Print["PASS: all squared amplitudes saved"];
Quit[0];

```

## Hgg/s03_result/reference/s01_amplitudes.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-7", "appendix": "Hgg/README_sources.md", "bytes": 2258, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "Hgg/s03_result/reference/s01_amplitudes.wls", "sha256": "c708d0fb865e69d106aac475efab4ea97594d50626a46fec2adc3ffb03239188"} -->
```wolfram
$HistoryLength = 0;
$FeynCalcStartupMessages = False;
$LoadAddOns = {"FeynArts"};
Get["FeynCalc`"];
SetDirectory[DirectoryName[$InputFileName]];
If[!DirectoryQ["s01_result"], CreateDirectory["s01_result"]];
require[condition_, message_] := If[!TrueQ[condition], Print["FAIL: ", message]; Quit[1]];

generate[name_, incoming_, outgoing_, momentaIn_, momentaOut_] := Module[{graphs, raw, amps},
  Print["Generating ", name];
  graphs = InsertFields[CreateTopologies[0, Length[incoming] -> Length[outgoing]],
    incoming -> outgoing, Model -> "SMQCD", InsertionLevel -> {Particles}];
  raw = CreateFeynAmp[graphs, Truncated -> False, PreFactor -> 1];
  amps = FCFAConvert[raw, IncomingMomenta -> momentaIn, OutgoingMomenta -> momentaOut,
    UndoChiralSplittings -> True, ChangeDimension -> D, List -> True, SMP -> True,
    Contract -> False, DropSumOver -> True,
    FinalSubstitutions -> {SMP["m_u"] -> 0, SMP["m_d"] -> 0,
      SMP["e"] -> ee, SMP["g_s"] -> gs}] /. {GaugeXi[_] -> 1, MQU[_] -> 0, MQD[_] -> 0};
  (* The SM up-quark charge is replaced by a symbolic charge at amplitude level. *)
  amps = amps /. ee -> ee eq/(2/3);
  require[Length[amps] > 0 && FreeQ[amps, _FCFAConvert], name <> " generation"];
  Put[<|"graphs" -> graphs, "raw" -> raw, "amplitudes" -> amps,
    "incoming" -> momentaIn, "outgoing" -> momentaOut|>, "s01_result/" <> name <> ".wl"];
  Print[name, ": ", Length[amps], " diagrams; ", ByteCount[amps], " bytes"];
  Length[amps]
];

outcome = MemoryConstrained[
  <|"real" -> generate["real", {V[1], V[5]}, {V[5], F[3, {1}], -F[3, {1}]},
       {q, p}, {k1, k2, k3}],
    "born_qg" -> generate["born_qg", {V[1], F[3, {1}]}, {V[5], F[3, {1}]},
       {q, p}, {k1, k2}],
    "born_gq" -> generate["born_gq", {V[1], V[5]}, {F[3, {1}], -F[3, {1}]},
       {q, p}, {k1, k2}]|>, 4*1024^3, $Aborted];
require[outcome =!= $Aborted, "memory limit"];
Put[<|"diagram_counts" -> outcome, "wolfram" -> $Version,
  "feyncalc" -> $FeynCalcVersion, "channel" -> "gamma* g -> g q qbar",
  "charge" -> "one massless flavour with symbolic charge eq",
  "photon_coupling" -> "divide the squared amplitude by ee^2 for the current tensor",
  "dimension" -> HoldForm[4 - 2 eps]|>, "s01_result/manifest.wl"];
Print["PASS: amplitudes saved"];
Quit[0];

```
<!-- END SOURCE -->

## Hgg/s05_component_sums_result/reference_before_parent_binding/s05_assemble_Hgg_component_sum.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-10", "appendix": "Hgg/README_sources.md", "bytes": 7201, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "Hgg/s05_component_sums_result/reference_before_parent_binding/s05_assemble_Hgg_component_sum.wls", "sha256": "d4fccfd8b19663ad6ce26c36eb18f03a0f4a4b284896d408529fcd18aa45abec"} -->
```wolfram
(* Assemble one complete saved projection without retaining the other tensors. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
componentSumPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_assemble_Hgg_component_sum.wls"}];
componentSumBase = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_assemble_Hgg_completed_pairs.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[componentSumBase, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "849cbecf55c4b8f9e0a6765e1c4396ae12b5beb67500fcd043d3bf57d21e71f8", Quit[1]];
componentSumBaseText = StringTrim[Import[componentSumBase, "Text"]];
componentSumTerminal = "ToExpression[assemblyRunTail, InputForm];";
If[!StringEndsQ[componentSumBaseText, componentSumTerminal] ||
  !SyntaxQ[Import[componentSumPath, "Text"]], Quit[1]];
componentSumBootstrap = StringDrop[componentSumBaseText, -StringLength[componentSumTerminal]];
If[!SyntaxQ[componentSumBootstrap], Quit[1]];
ToExpression[componentSumBootstrap, InputForm];
assembleCompletedPairs[] := Module[{key, paths, expectedPaths, values = {}, record, value,
  indices, scalarKeys, keys, metadata = {}, binding, control, controlPath, controlChecks,
  controlReceipt, controlRelative, output, result, seconds, report, started = AbsoluteTime[]},
  gate["serial bounded component assembly", channel === "Hgg" && workerCount === 0 && !validationOnly];
  key = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_SUM_KEY"];
  gate["requested component key", StringQ[key] && StringMatchQ[key, (LetterCharacter | DigitCharacter | "_") ..]];
  paths = Lookup[assemblyManifest["pairs"], "file"];
  expectedPaths = (StringDrop[FileNameJoin[{cache, label <> "_" <> ToString[First[#]] <>
    "_" <> ToString[Last[#]] <> ".wl"}], StringLength[root] + 1] &) /@ pairs;
  gate["same complete generated pair inventory", Sort[paths] === Sort[expectedPaths] && DuplicateFreeQ[paths]];
  Do[gate["pinned completed pair " <> row["file"], IntegerString[FileHash[
    FileNameJoin[{root, row["file"]}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] === row["sha256"]], {row, assemblyManifest["pairs"]}];
  controlRelative = channel <> "/s05_component_sums_result/Photon_1_1/";
  If[key =!= "Photon_1_1",
    controlReceipt = Import[FileNameJoin[{root, controlRelative, "s05_execution.json"}], "RawJSON"];
    controlChecks = Import[FileNameJoin[{root, controlRelative, "s05_checks.json"}], "RawJSON"];
    gate["accepted own complete component control", TrueQ[controlReceipt["passed"]] &&
      controlReceipt["result_sha256"][controlRelative <> "s05_checks.json"] === IntegerString[
        FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, controlRelative, "s05_checks.json"}], "SHA256"], 16, 64] &&
      TrueQ[controlChecks["exact_own_accepted_sum_comparison"]] &&
      controlChecks["source_sha256"] === IntegerString[FileHash[componentSumPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] &&
      controlChecks["manifest_sha256"] === IntegerString[FileHash[assemblyManifestPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] &&
      controlChecks["input_hash"] === IntegerString[inputHash, 16, 64] &&
      controlChecks["native_versions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}]];
  Clear[componentPacket, componentProof]; ClearSystemCache[];
  Do[
    Print["COMPONENT_PAIR_READ ", key, " ", pair, " memory ", MemoryInUse[]];
    record = bounded[pairTask[pair], {key, pair, "accepted pair reader"}];
    gate["accepted complete parent and conventions", AssociationQ[record] && record["InputHash"] === inputHash &&
      record["SectorWardComparisonHash"] === wardProofHash && And @@ Values[record["Checks"]] &&
      Dimensions[record["PhotonMatrix"]] === {Length[photonSymbols], Length[photonSymbols]}];
    If[metadata === {},
      scalarKeys = DeleteCases[Keys[record["ScalarModes"]], "PhotonWard"];
      keys = Join[Flatten[Table["Photon_" <> ToString[a] <> "_" <> ToString[b],
        {a, Length[photonSymbols]}, {b, Length[photonSymbols]}]], ("Scalar_" <> # &) /@ scalarKeys];
      gate["requested component belongs to generated inventory", MemberQ[keys, key]]];
    gate["common saved scalar inventory", DeleteCases[Keys[record["ScalarModes"]], "PhotonWard"] === scalarKeys];
    value = If[StringStartsQ[key, "Photon_"],
      indices = FromDigits /@ Rest[StringSplit[key, "_"]]; Extract[record["PhotonMatrix"], indices],
      record["ScalarModes"][StringDrop[key, StringLength["Scalar_"]]]];
    AppendTo[values, value]; AppendTo[metadata, KeyDrop[record, {"PhotonMatrix", "ScalarModes"}]];
    Clear[value, record]; ClearSystemCache[], {pair, pairs}];
  gate["complete original component inputs", Length[values] === Length[pairs] && AllTrue[metadata, AssociationQ]];
  Print["COMPONENT_SUM_BINDING ", key, " input_bytes ", ByteCount[values], " memory ", MemoryInUse[]];
  binding = bounded[Hash[{inputHash, label, key, values}, "SHA256"], {key, "original sum binding"}];
  {seconds, value} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[linearComponentSum[<|"Key" -> key, "Values" -> values|>], {key, "original linear sum"}]];
  If[key === "Photon_1_1",
    controlPath = FileNameJoin[{root, assemblyManifest["sum_control"]["file"]}];
    gate["pinned original complete sum", IntegerString[FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === assemblyManifest["sum_control"]["sha256"]];
    control = bounded[Get[controlPath], "original complete sum reader"];
    gate["entire own accepted sum exactly reproduced", control["InputHash"] === inputHash &&
      control["Key"] === key && control["SumInputHash"] === binding && And @@ Values[control["Checks"]] &&
      value === control["Value"]]; Clear[control]];
  Clear[values]; ClearSystemCache[];
  output = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_component_sums_result", key}];
  If[!DirectoryQ[output], CreateDirectory[output, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
  result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-complete-component-sum-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
    "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "SumInputHash" -> binding, "Key" -> key,
    "Value" -> value, "PairMetadata" -> metadata, "CompleteKeys" -> keys,
    "SourceHash" -> FileHash[componentSumPath, "SHA256"], "ManifestHash" -> FileHash[assemblyManifestPath, "SHA256"],
    "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}, "Checks" -> checks,
    "OriginalLinearSumDefinitions" -> DownValues[linearComponentSum], "SumSeconds" -> seconds,
    "ElapsedSeconds" -> AbsoluteTime[] - started, "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[],
    "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
  put[result, FileNameJoin[{output, "s05_result.wl"}]];
  report = <|"channel" -> channel, "key" -> key, "all_component_keys" -> keys, "checks" -> checks,
    "source_sha256" -> IntegerString[FileHash[componentSumPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64],
    "manifest_sha256" -> IntegerString[FileHash[assemblyManifestPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64],
    "input_hash" -> IntegerString[inputHash, 16, 64], "native_versions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
    "exact_own_accepted_sum_comparison" -> True, "sum_seconds" -> seconds,
    "elapsed_seconds" -> AbsoluteTime[] - started, "peak_kernel_memory_bytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[],
    "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>;
  Export[FileNameJoin[{output, "s05_checks.json"}], report, "RawJSON"];
  Print["PASS: s05_assemble_Hgg_component_sum"]; Quit[0]];
gate["unchanged original assembly caller", StringCount[assemblyRunTail, "assembleCompletedPairs[];"] === 1];
ToExpression[assemblyRunTail, InputForm];

```

## Hgg/s05_component_sums_result/reference_before_parent_binding/s05_project_Hgg_component_sum.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-11", "appendix": "Hgg/README_sources.md", "bytes": 9825, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "Hgg/s05_component_sums_result/reference_before_parent_binding/s05_project_Hgg_component_sum.wls", "sha256": "2e15e4be0786427c798c949bc204c03f225dc991fd1c0f9cd7c7216b8e9f224d"} -->
```wolfram
(* Project one accepted complete photon sum with the original spin equations. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
projectSource = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_project_Hgg_component_sum.wls"}];
projectBase = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s05_assemble_Hgg_component_sum.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[projectBase, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "d4fccfd8b19663ad6ce26c36eb18f03a0f4a4b284896d408529fcd18aa45abec", Quit[1]];
projectBaseText = StringTrim[Import[projectBase, "Text"]];
projectTerminal = "ToExpression[assemblyRunTail, InputForm];";
If[!StringEndsQ[projectBaseText, projectTerminal] || !SyntaxQ[Import[projectSource, "Text"]], Quit[1]];
projectBootstrap = StringDrop[projectBaseText, -StringLength[projectTerminal]];
If[!SyntaxQ[projectBootstrap], Quit[1]];
ToExpression[projectBootstrap, InputForm];

assembleCompletedPairs[] := Module[{setting, component, dual, shape, generic, genericCoefficients,
  positions, required, entries = <||>, sumHashes = <||>, record, receipt, relative, path, key,
  controlPath, control, controlPhoton, controlResponse, originalPassed, candidate, proof, proofPath,
  originalSeconds, candidateSeconds, ownConjugate, conjugationSeconds, photon, response,
  reconstruction, responseSeconds, reconstructed, cdrRules, cdrAverage, directory, result, report,
  started = AbsoluteTime[]},
  gate["bounded own projection setup", channel === "Hgg" && labels === {label} && workerCount === 0 && !validationOnly];
  setting = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_PROJECT_COMPONENT"];
  gate["integer requested photon component", StringQ[setting] && StringMatchQ[setting, DigitCharacter ..]];
  component = FromDigits[setting];
  gate["requested photon component belongs to basis", 1 <= component <= Length[basis["PhotonDual"]]];
  dual = basis["PhotonDual"][[component]]; shape = Dimensions[dual];
  gate["complete square photon basis", shape === {Length[photonSymbols], Length[photonSymbols]}];
  generic = Table[Unique["sidisPhotonEntry"], {shape[[1]]}, {shape[[2]]}];
  genericCoefficients = Tr[#.generic] & /@ basis["PhotonDual"];
  gate["original photon inverse for every matrix entry", Expand[generic -
    Total[MapThread[Times, {genericCoefficients, basis["PhotonBasis"]}]]] === ConstantArray[0, shape]];
  positions = Position[Transpose[dual], value_ /; value =!= 0, {2}, Heads -> False];
  gate["nonempty actual photon support", positions =!= {} && AllTrue[positions,
    MatchQ[#, {_Integer, _Integer}] && And @@ MapThread[1 <= #1 <= #2 &, {#, shape}] &]];
  required = Union[positions, Reverse /@ positions];
  gate["actual photon support reproduces original trace", Expand[genericCoefficients[[component]] -
    Total[(Extract[Transpose[dual], #] Extract[generic, #] &) /@ positions]] === 0];

  proofPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "Hqq", "s05_structural_reconstruction_result", "s05_result.wl"}];
  gate["pinned reusable reconstruction algorithm", IntegerString[FileHash[proofPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] ===
    "b8d397e29a9b9210e2d4db1aabf361eb5ece0c338bbe0c93d0fd846fc8be44de"];
  proof = Get[proofPath];
  gate["accepted reconstruction implementation and extraction", TrueQ[proof["Accepted"]] &&
    And @@ Values[proof["Checks"]] && proof["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion} &&
    proof["ExtractionDefinitions"] === DownValues[compactSpinResponse]];
  DownValues[structuralSpinReconstruction] = proof["CandidateDefinitions"];
  gate["unchanged executed structural algorithm", DownValues[structuralSpinReconstruction] === proof["CandidateDefinitions"]];
  Clear[componentPacket, componentProof]; ClearSystemCache[];
  controlPath = FileNameJoin[{root, First[assemblyManifest["pairs"]]["file"]}];
  gate["own accepted first diagonal pair identity", First[pairs][[1]] === First[pairs][[2]] &&
    FileBaseName[controlPath] === label <> "_" <> StringRiffle[ToString /@ First[pairs], "_"] &&
    IntegerString[FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === First[assemblyManifest["pairs"]]["sha256"]];
  control = bounded[Get[controlPath], "own projection control reader"];
  gate["own accepted control conventions", control["InputHash"] === inputHash &&
    control["SectorWardComparisonHash"] === wardProofHash && And @@ Values[control["Checks"]]];
  controlPhoton = Tr[dual.control["PhotonMatrix"]];
  controlResponse = First[bounded[compactSpinResponse[{controlPhoton}, inVariables, outVariables], "own original spin extraction"]];
  {originalSeconds, originalPassed} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[zero[controlPhoton -
    Sum[inVariables[[i]] outVariables[[j]] controlResponse[[j, i]],
      {i, Length[inVariables]}, {j, Length[outVariables]}]], "own original spin reconstruction"]];
  {candidateSeconds, candidate} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[structuralSpinReconstruction[
    controlPhoton, controlResponse, inVariables, outVariables], "own structural reconstruction comparison"]];
  gate["own complete original reconstruction reproduced", TrueQ[originalPassed] &&
    candidate["Accepted"] === originalPassed && And @@ Values[candidate["Checks"]]];
  {conjugationSeconds, ownConjugate} = AbsoluteTiming[bounded[
    zeroArray[control["PhotonMatrix"] - Transpose[Map[factoredRealConjugate, control["PhotonMatrix"], {2}]]],
    "own factored Hermiticity comparison"]];
  gate["own original Hermiticity reproduced", TrueQ[ownConjugate] && ownConjugate === bounded[
    zeroArray[algebraicReduce[ComplexExpand[control["PhotonMatrix"] - ConjugateTranspose[control["PhotonMatrix"]]]]],
    "own original Hermiticity"]];
  Clear[control, controlPhoton, controlResponse, proof]; ClearSystemCache[];

  Do[
    key = "Photon_" <> StringRiffle[ToString /@ position, "_"];
    relative = channel <> "/s05_component_sums_result/" <> key <> "/s05_result.wl";
    path = FileNameJoin[{root, relative}];
    receipt = Import[FileNameJoin[{DirectoryName[path], "s05_execution.json"}], "RawJSON"];
    gate["accepted complete sum file " <> key, TrueQ[receipt["passed"]] &&
      receipt["result_sha256"][relative] === IntegerString[FileHash[path, "SHA256"], 16, 64]];
    record = bounded[Get[path], {key, "complete sum reader"}];
    gate["complete sum conventions " <> key, record["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-complete-component-sum-v1" &&
      record["InputHash"] === inputHash && record["InputHashes"] === inputHashes && record["Key"] === key &&
      record["SourceHash"] === FileHash[projectBase, "SHA256"] &&
      record["ManifestHash"] === FileHash[assemblyManifestPath, "SHA256"] &&
      record["NativeVersions"] === {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion} && And @@ Values[record["Checks"]]];
    AssociateTo[entries, key -> record["Value"]]; AssociateTo[sumHashes, relative -> FileHash[path, "SHA256"]];
    Clear[record]; ClearSystemCache[], {position, required}];
  Do[
    key = "Photon_" <> StringRiffle[ToString /@ position, "_"];
    gate["complete sum Hermiticity " <> key, bounded[zeroArray[entries[key] - factoredRealConjugate[
      entries["Photon_" <> StringRiffle[ToString /@ Reverse[position], "_"]]]], {key, "full native Hermiticity"}]],
    {position, positions}];
  photon = Total[(Extract[Transpose[dual], #] entries["Photon_" <> StringRiffle[ToString /@ #, "_"]] &) /@ positions];
  Clear[entries]; ClearSystemCache[];
  {responseSeconds, response} = AbsoluteTiming[First[bounded[
    compactSpinResponse[{photon}, inVariables, outVariables], "complete original spin extraction"]]];
  reconstruction = bounded[structuralSpinReconstruction[photon, response, inVariables, outVariables],
    "complete native spin reconstruction"];
  gate["entire actual spin polynomial reconstructed", TrueQ[reconstruction["Accepted"]] && And @@ Values[reconstruction["Checks"]]];
  cdrRules = Thread[Join[Rest[inVariables], Rest[outVariables]] ->
    (If[MemberQ[{eIn, eOut}, #], 1, 0] & /@ Join[Rest[inVariables], Rest[outVariables]])];
  cdrAverage = If[incomingQuark, 1, basis["IncomingDensityNormalization"]/gluonDimensions[p]];
  reconstructed = cdrAverage (photon /. cdrRules);
  Clear[photon]; ClearSystemCache[];
  directory = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_projected_components_result", "Photon_" <> ToString[component]}];
  If[!DirectoryQ[directory], CreateDirectory[directory, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
  result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-complete-photon-spin-component-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
    "Component" -> component, "PhotonLabel" -> basis["PhotonLabels"][[component]], "Response" -> response,
    "CDRPhotonCoefficient" -> reconstructed, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
    "SumInputHashes" -> sumHashes, "SourceHash" -> FileHash[projectSource, "SHA256"],
    "BasisHash" -> FileHash[basisPath, "SHA256"], "ControlHash" -> FileHash[controlPath, "SHA256"],
    "ReconstructionAlgorithmHash" -> FileHash[proofPath, "SHA256"], "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
    "IncomingVariables" -> inVariables, "OutgoingVariables" -> outVariables, "Reconstruction" -> reconstruction,
    "OriginalControlSeconds" -> originalSeconds, "CandidateControlSeconds" -> candidateSeconds,
    "ResponseSeconds" -> responseSeconds, "ElapsedSeconds" -> AbsoluteTime[] - started,
    "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[], "Checks" -> checks, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False|>;
  put[result, FileNameJoin[{directory, "s05_result.wl"}]];
  report = <|"channel" -> channel, "component" -> component, "checks" -> checks,
    "response_bytes" -> ByteCount[response], "original_control_seconds" -> originalSeconds,
    "candidate_control_seconds" -> candidateSeconds, "response_seconds" -> responseSeconds,
    "elapsed_seconds" -> AbsoluteTime[] - started, "peak_kernel_memory_bytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[],
    "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False|>;
  Export[FileNameJoin[{directory, "s05_checks.json"}], report, "RawJSON"];
  Print["PASS: s05_project_Hgg_component_sum"]; Quit[0]];
ToExpression[assemblyRunTail, InputForm];

```

## Hgg/s08_component_input_result/reference_before_context/s08_map_Hgg_component_inputs.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-23", "appendix": "Hgg/README_sources.md", "bytes": 12182, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "Hgg/s08_component_input_result/reference_before_context/s08_map_Hgg_component_inputs.wls", "sha256": "52b68fcea5f7285fa4752550fcd37c85a309f7af1daabeca4c05f33bc72a44b7"} -->
```wolfram
(* Keep the accepted mapper; read one pinned Hgg photon payload per worker. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
hggAdapterPath = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_map_Hgg_component_inputs.wls"}];
hggMode = Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_COMPONENT_STAGE"];
If[Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_CHANNEL"] =!= "Hgg" || !MemberQ[{"targets", "coefficients"}, hggMode] ||
  !SyntaxQ[Import[hggAdapterPath, "Text"]], Quit[1]];
hggReplace[text_, old_, new_] := Module[{changed},
  If[StringCount[text, old] =!= 1, Print["FAIL: unique Hgg loading interface"]; Quit[1]];
  changed = StringReplace[text, old -> new];
  If[!SyntaxQ[changed] || StringReplace[changed, new -> old] =!= text,
    Print["FAIL: unchanged Hgg scientific source restoration"]; Quit[1]]; changed];
hggReplaceInventory[text_] := Module[{first, last, original},
  If[StringCount[text, "tasks = {}; bookkeeping = <||>;"] =!= 1 ||
    StringCount[text, "\nruleKeys = First /@ reduction[\"Rules\"];"] =!= 1, Quit[1]];
  first = First[First[StringPosition[text, "tasks = {}; bookkeeping = <||>;"]]];
  last = First[First[StringPosition[text, "\nruleKeys = First /@ reduction[\"Rules\"];"]]] - 1;
  original = StringTake[text, {first, last}];
  If[original =!= hggOriginalInventory, Print["FAIL: original task inventory identity"]; Quit[1]];
  hggReplace[text, original, "hggInitializeTasks[];"]];
hggOriginalMapper = FileNameJoin[{Directory[], "common", "s08_result", "reference",
  "s08_map_real_spin_before_known_denominator.wls"}];
If[IntegerString[FileHash[hggOriginalMapper, "SHA256"], 16, 64] =!=
  "e23a79589bfce183535a6f1166eda799a9f119168feb9cff1b13feb669c8b21f", Quit[1]];
hggOriginalText = Import[hggOriginalMapper, "Text"];
hggOriginalInventory = StringTake[hggOriginalText, {
  First[First[StringPosition[hggOriginalText, "tasks = {}; bookkeeping = <||>;"]]],
  First[First[StringPosition[hggOriginalText, "\nruleKeys = First /@ reduction[\"Rules\"];"]]] - 1}];

hggInitializeTasks[] := Module[{},
  gate["Hgg accepted bounded component interface", channel === "Hgg" &&
    KeyExistsQ[spin, "MappingTaskMetadata"] && KeyExistsQ[spin, "MappingTaskSources"] &&
    KeyExistsQ[spin, "ComponentStorage"]];
  hggTaskMetadata = spin["MappingTaskMetadata"]; hggTaskSources = spin["MappingTaskSources"]; hggTaskRoot = root;
  gate["Hgg complete distinct native task inventory", Length[hggTaskMetadata] > 0 &&
    Length[hggTaskMetadata] === Length[hggTaskSources] && DuplicateFreeQ[hggTaskMetadata] &&
    And @@ (Sort[Keys[#]] === Sort[{"Sector", "Kind", "Index"}] & /@ hggTaskMetadata)];
  bookkeeping = Association@Table[label -> KeyTake[spin["Sectors"][label], {
    "TagWeight", "TagWeightAppliedToTensor", "OutgoingFields", "IncomingSpinLabels",
    "OutgoingSpinLabels", "ChargeDegrees", "AmplitudeCouplingPowers"}], {label, Keys[spin["Sectors"]]}];
  tasks = Table[With[{taskIndex = index}, Join[hggTaskMetadata[[index]],
    <|"Value" :> hggTaskValue[taskIndex]|>]], {index, Length[hggTaskMetadata]}];
  gate["Hgg deferred tasks retain exact ordering", (KeyDrop[#, "Value"] & /@ tasks) === hggTaskMetadata];
  Clear[hggCachedKey, hggCachedValue];
  Print["HGG_COMPONENT_TASKS ", Length[tasks], " metadata_bytes ", ByteCount[tasks]]];

hggTaskValue[index_] := Module[{row, key, path, packet, positions, expected, actual},

      actual = {<|"Sector" -> First[expected]["Sector"], "Kind" -> "PhotonMetricD", "Index" -> {}|>}];
```

```wolfram
 {factor,core}];
```

```wolfram
      28*Q^2*s^5*s23^2*(-a - s23 + t)^5 + 4*Q^8*s*s23^3*(-a - s23 + t)^5 - 
      8*Q^6*s^2*s23^3*(-a - s23 + t)^5 - 28*Q^4*s^3*s23^3*(-a - s23 + t)^5 + 
      32*Q^2*s^4*s23^3*(-a - s23 + t)^5 - 2*Q^8*s23^4*(-a - s23 + t)^5 - 
      6*Q^6*s*s23^4*(-a - s23 + t)^5 + 26*Q^4*s^2*s23^4*(-a - s23 + t)^5 - 
      18*Q^2*s^3*s23^4*(-a - s23 + t)^5 + 4*Q^6*s23^5*(-a - s23 + t)^5 - 
      8*Q^4*s*s23^5*(-a - s23 + t)^5 + 4*Q^2*s^2*s23^5*(-a - s23 + t)^5 + 
      6*Q^6*s^4*t*(-a - s23 + t)^5 - 2*Q^4*s^5*t*(-a - s23 + t)^5 - 
      6*Q^2*s^6*t*(-a - s23 + t)^5 + 2*s^7*t*(-a - s23 + t)^5 - 
      16*Q^6*s^3*s23*t*(-a - s23 + t)^5 - 8*Q^4*s^4*s23*t*(-a - s23 + t)^5 + 
      32*Q^2*s^5*s23*t*(-a - s23 + t)^5 - 8*s^6*s23*t*(-a - s23 + t)^5 + 
      12*Q^6*s^2*s23^2*t*(-a - s23 + t)^5 + 36*Q^4*s^3*s23^2*t*
       (-a - s23 + t)^5 - 60*Q^2*s^4*s23^2*t*(-a - s23 + t)^5 + 
      12*s^5*s23^2*t*(-a - s23 + t)^5 - 40*Q^4*s^2*s23^3*t*(-a - s23 + t)^5 + 
      48*Q^2*s^3*s23^3*t*(-a - s23 + t)^5 - 8*s^4*s23^3*t*(-a - s23 + t)^5 - 
      2*Q^6*s23^4*t*(-a - s23 + t)^5 + 14*Q^4*s*s23^4*t*(-a - s23 + t)^5 - 
      14*Q^2*s^2*s23^4*t*(-a - s23 + t)^5 + 2*s^3*s23^4*t*(-a - s23 + t)^5 + 
      4*Q^4*s^4*t^2*(-a - s23 + t)^5 - 8*Q^2*s^5*t^2*(-a - s23 + t)^5 + 
      4*s^6*t^2*(-a - s23 + t)^5 - 12*Q^4*s^3*s23*t^2*(-a - s23 + t)^5 + 
      24*Q^2*s^4*s23*t^2*(-a - s23 + t)^5 - 12*s^5*s23*t^2*(-a - s23 + t)^5 + 
      12*Q^4*s^2*s23^2*t^2*(-a - s23 + t)^5 - 24*Q^2*s^3*s23^2*t^2*
       (-a - s23 + t)^5 + 12*s^4*s23^2*t^2*(-a - s23 + t)^5 - 
      4*Q^4*s*s23^3*t^2*(-a - s23 + t)^5 + 8*Q^2*s^2*s23^3*t^2*
       (-a - s23 + t)^5 - 4*s^3*s23^3*t^2*(-a - s23 + t)^5)/
     (b*(a + b - Q^2 - s + s23 - t)^2)}}, 
 "Denominators" -> {a, -a - s23 + t, b, -b + s - s23, -a - b - Q^2 - s23, 
   a + b - Q^2 - s + s23 - t}, "FamilyDefinitions" -> 
  {HoldPattern[familyRows[expression_, family_]] :> 
    Module[{spec, variables, rational, numerator, denominator, powers, 
      constant, inputRules, inputReconstruction, pieces, polynomial, rows, 
      reconstruction}, spec = families[family]; 
      variables = First /@ spec["UncutCoordinateRules"]; 
      Print["POLYNOMIAL_FAMILY_INPUT ", family]; 
      rational = Together[expression]; numerator = Numerator[rational]; 
      denominator = Factor[Denominator[rational] /. 
         spec["UncutCoordinateRules"]]; 
      gate["original family numerator polynomial", PolynomialQ[numerator, 
        variables]]; powers = (Exponent[denominator, #1] & ) /@ 
        polynomialVariables; constant = 
       Cancel[denominator/Times @@ MapThread[Power, {polynomialVariables, 
            powers}]]; gate["family denominator is a Laurent monomial", 
       FreeQ[constant, Alternatives @@ polynomialVariables]]; 
      inputRules = CoefficientRules[numerator, variables]; 
      inputReconstruction = 
       Total[(Last[#1]*Times @@ MapThread[Power, {variables, 
              First[#1]}] & ) /@ inputRules]; 
      gate["original numerator coefficients reconstruct", 
       zero[inputReconstruction - numerator]]; 
      pieces = Function[entry, Module[{monomial, shifted, shiftRules, 
           shiftReconstruction}, monomial = Times @@ MapThread[Power, 
              {variables, First[entry]}]; shifted = monomial /. 
             spec["UncutCoordinateRules"]; shiftRules = CoefficientRules[
             Expand[shifted], polynomialVariables]; shiftReconstruction = 
            Total[(Last[#1]*Times @@ MapThread[Power, {polynomialVariables, 
                   First[#1]}] & ) /@ shiftRules]; 
           gate["loop monomial substitution reconstructs", 
            zero[shiftReconstruction - shifted]]; Association[
            (First[#1] -> Last[entry]*Last[#1] & ) /@ shiftRules]]] /@ 
        inputRules; polynomial = Merge[pieces, Total]; 
      rows = Association[KeyValueMap[Function[{key, value}, 
          CutIntegral[family, Join[ConstantArray[1, Length[geometry[
                "CutMomenta"]]], powers - key]] -> 
           Factor[Together[value/constant]]], polynomial]]; 
      rows = Select[rows, #1 =!= 0 & ]; 
      gate["family Laurent coefficients reconstruct", 
       certifyFamilyLaurent[polynomial, rows, powers, constant, family]]; 
      rows]}, "OriginalMapDefinitions" -> 
  {HoldPattern[externalOriginalMap[expression_]] :> 
    Module[{powers, prefactor, decomposition, pieces, rows, reconstruction},

       extractAtoms[expression]; decomposition = decompose[powers]; 
      pieces = KeyValueMap[Function[{key, coefficient}, 
         Module[{indices = List @@ key, support, family, value}, 
          support = Flatten[Position[indices, _?(#1 > 0 & )]];

                families[#1]["UncutIndices"]] === {} & , 
             Missing["NoFamily"]]; gate[
            "every independent denominator set has a family", 
             !MissingQ[family]]; value = Cancel[prefactor*(coefficient/
               Times @@ MapThread[Power, {denominators, indices}])]; 
           familyRows[value, family]]], decomposition]; rows = merge[pieces]; 
      gate["complete cut-family map reconstructs the input tensor", 
       certifyScalarReconstruction[expression, powers, prefactor, 
        decomposition, pieces, rows]]; 
      gate["both physical cuts remain to unit power in every target", 
       And @@ (Take[#1[[2]], 2] === ConstantArray[1, 
            Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]] & ) /@ Keys[rows]]; rows]}|>
```

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-35", "appendix": "Hgg/README_sources.md", "bytes": 3008, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "Hgg/s08_metric_input_result/s08_equations.wl", "sha256": "5070b9b2a9f430eec3a4f173bbe6d50d7a3456012ae2660791c939353a7c283b"} -->
```wolfram
<|"Task" -> <|"Sector" -> "Real", "Kind" -> "PhotonMetricD", "Index" -> {}|>, 
 "RejectedTerm" -> {}, "Numerator" -> {}, "Denominator" -> {}, 
 "NonPolynomialPowers" -> {}, "Variables" -> {a, b}, 
 "Denominators" -> {a, -a - s23 + t, b, -b + s - s23, -a - b - Q^2 - s23, 
   a + b - Q^2 - s + s23 - t}, "OriginalExtractionDefinitions" -> 
  {HoldPattern[extractAtoms[expression_]] :> 
    Module[{rational, factors, powers, found, ratio, prefactor}, 
     rational = Together[expression]; factors = 
       Rest[FactorList[Denominator[rational]]]; 
      powers = ConstantArray[0, Length[denominators]]; 
      Do[If[ !FreeQ[factor[[1]], a | b], 
        found = SelectFirst[Range[Length[denominators]], Function[index, 
            ratio = Cancel[factor[[1]]/denominators[[index]]]; 
             ratio =!= 0 && FreeQ[ratio, a | b]], 
           Missing["UnknownPropagator"]]; If[MissingQ[found], 
          Print["UNKNOWN_PROPAGATOR ", InputForm[factor[[1]]]]]; 
         gate["every loop-dependent factor is a generated propagator", 
           !MissingQ[found]]; powers[[found]] += factor[[2]]], 
       {factor, factors}]; prefactor = 
       Cancel[rational*Times @@ MapThread[Power, {denominators, powers}]]; 
      gate["atom extraction leaves a polynomial numerator", 
       FreeQ[Denominator[Together[prefactor]], a | b]]; 
      {powers, prefactor}]}, "FactoredExtractionDefinitions" -> 
  {HoldPattern[factoredAtoms[expression_]] :> 
    Module[{numerator, denominator, factors, powers, found, ratio, product, 
      scale, prefactor}, numerator = Numerator[expression]; 
      denominator = Denominator[expression]; 
      gate["original explicit rational input reconstructs", 
       numerator/denominator === expression]; 
      gate["explicit numerator is a loop polynomial", PolynomialQ[numerator, 
        atomVariables]]; gate["explicit denominator is a loop polynomial", 
       PolynomialQ[denominator, atomVariables]]; 
      factors = Rest[FactorList[denominator]]; 
      powers = ConstantArray[0, Length[denominators]]; 
      Do[If[ !FreeQ[factor[[1]], Alternatives @@ atomVariables], 
        found = SelectFirst[Range[Length[denominators]], Function[index, 
            ratio = Cancel[factor[[1]]/denominators[[index]]]; 
             ratio =!= 0 && FreeQ[ratio, Alternatives @@ atomVariables]], 
           Missing["UnknownPropagator"]]; 
         gate["every loop-dependent factor is a generated propagator", 
           !MissingQ[found]]; powers[[found]] += factor[[2]]], 
       {factor, factors}]; product = Times @@ MapThread[Power, 
         {denominators, powers}]; scale = Cancel[product/denominator]; 
      gate["denominator ratio is loop independent", 
       FreeQ[scale, Alternatives @@ atomVariables]]; 
      gate["complete denominator scale reconstructs", 
       zero[scale*denominator - product]]; prefactor = scale*numerator; 
      gate["atom extraction leaves a polynomial numerator", 
       PolynomialQ[prefactor, atomVariables]]; {powers, prefactor}]}|>

```

## Hgg/s10_reduce_Hgg_coefficients.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-45", "appendix": "Hgg/README_sources.md", "bytes": 44042, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "Hgg/s10_reduce_Hgg_coefficients.wls", "sha256": "e96ebb6cdab4dd44aaf69332668dc5b906c72a24fcdbe68f069a783602e6270b"} -->
```wolfram
(* Map new spin numerators with the unchanged accepted real-integral mapper. *)
$HistoryLength = 0;
$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;Get["FeynCalc`"];
root = DirectoryName[DirectoryName[ExpandFileName[$InputFileName]]]; SetDirectory[root]; root=Directory[];
sourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_map_real_spin_compact_inputs.wls"}];
compactBaselinePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_map_real_spin_streamed.wls"}];
calculationSourcePath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_map_real_spin.wls"}];
channel = "Hgg";
localSource = FileNameJoin[{root,"Hgg","s10_reduce_Hgg_coefficients.wls"}];
localConfigPath = FileNameJoin[{root,"Hgg","s10_coefficient_inputs.json"}];
localConfig = Import[localConfigPath,"RawJSON"];
checks = <||>;
gate[name_, test_] := If[TrueQ[test],
  If[!KeyExistsQ[checks, name], Print["PASS: ", name]]; AssociateTo[checks, name -> True],
  Print["FAIL: ", name]; If[TrueQ[$KernelID > 0], Throw[$Failed, "RealMapFailure"], CloseKernels[]; Quit[1]]];
gate["authorized local coefficient execution",Environment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_LOCAL_AUTHORIZED"]==="1"&&$VersionNumber===15.];
gate["bound complete local source",SyntaxQ[ReadString[localSource]]&&
 IntegerString[FileHash[localSource,"SHA256"],16,64]===localConfig["source_sha256"]];
KeyValueMap[Function[{relative,identity},gate["pinned local coefficient input "<>relative,
 IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,relative}],"SHA256"],16,64]===identity]],localConfig["input_sha256"]];

localMapPath=FileNameJoin[{root,"misc","s08_result","s08_result.wl"}];localMap=Get[localMapPath];
localImportedVersions=localMap["ImportedNativeVersions"];
gate["accepted local component storage",localMap["ComponentStorage"]==="hash-pinned-raw-component-files-v1"&&
 localMap["NativeVersions"]==={$Version,$FeynCalcVersion}&&Last[localImportedVersions]===$FeynCalcVersion];
Do[localReceipt=Import[FileNameJoin[{root,row[[1]]}],"RawJSON"];
 gate["accepted local upstream receipt "<>row[[1]],TrueQ[localReceipt["passed"]]&&localReceipt["execution_backend"]==="local"&&
  localReceipt["result_sha256"][row[[2]]]===IntegerString[FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root,row[[2]]}],"SHA256"],16,64]],
 {row,{{"misc/s08_result/s08_execution.json","misc/s08_result/s08_result.wl"},
       {"misc/s09_result/s09_execution.json","misc/s09_result/s09_reduction.wl"}}}];
SetEnvironment["POLARIZED_SIDIS_REAL_REDUCTION"->"misc/s09_result/s09_reduction.wl"];
localRawInputHash=localMap["InputHash"];
localReadRaw[index_]:=Module[{row,path,value},row=rawTargetComponents[[index]];path=FileNameJoin[{root,row["RawCoefficientFile"]}];
 gate["exact saved raw file",IntegerString[FileHash[path,"SHA256"],16,64]===row["RawCoefficientSHA256"]];
 value=bounded[Get[path],{index,"saved raw component"}];
 gate["raw reader returns complete original record",KeyDrop[value,"Coefficients"]===KeyDrop[row,
  {"RawTargets","RawCoefficientFile","RawCoefficientSHA256"}]&&Keys[value["Coefficients"]]===row["RawTargets"]&&
  value["InputHash"]===localRawInputHash&&TrueQ[value["ReconstructionPassed"]]&&Length[value["Checks"]]>0&&And@@Values[value["Checks"]]];
 value];
localReducedComponent[index_]:=Block[{checks=<||>},Module[{full,answer},full=mapComponent[index];
 If[!AssociationQ[full],Return[full]];
 gate["complete reduced output accepted before storage projection",TrueQ[full["ReconstructionPassed"]]&&
  And@@Values[full["Checks"]]&&Keys[full["Coefficients"]]===rawTargetComponents[[index]]["RawTargets"]];
 answer=Join[KeyDrop[full,"Coefficients"],KeyTake[rawTargetComponents[[index]],
  {"RawTargets","RawCoefficientFile","RawCoefficientSHA256"}]];
 gate["exact downstream coefficient interface",KeyTake[answer,{"Sector","Kind","Index","ReducedCoefficients"}]===
  KeyTake[full,{"Sector","Kind","Index","ReducedCoefficients"}]];answer]];
gate["complete source syntax", SyntaxQ[Import[sourcePath, "Text"]]];
gate["unchanged streamed baseline", IntegerString[FileHash[compactBaselinePath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === "f65fbeee3345dcf281e60192a7e6ea4dfd08eb547f4aa7fb225134462e1ed601"];
SetAttributes[bounded, HoldFirst];
bounded[value_, label_] := MemoryConstrained[TimeConstrained[value, 1200,
  gate["time bound " <> ToString[label, InputForm], False]], 4*1024^3,
  gate["memory bound " <> ToString[label, InputForm], False]];
put[value_, path_] := (Put[value, path <> ".tmp"];
  RenameFile[path <> ".tmp", path, OverwriteTarget -> True]);
zero[value_] := Factor[Together[value]] === 0;
configPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s08_inputs.json"}];
config = Import[configPath, "RawJSON"];
originalMapperPath = FileNameJoin[{root, config["original_mapper"]}];
gate["pinned original mapper", IntegerString[FileHash[originalMapperPath, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === config["original_mapper_sha256"]];
originalText = Import[originalMapperPath, "Text"];
originalBlock = StringTake[originalText, {First[First[StringPosition[originalText, "merge[pieces_List]"]]],
  First[First[StringPosition[originalText, "mapTask[task_]"]]] - 1}];
gate["unchanged mapping functions", StringContainsQ[Import[localSource, "Text"], originalBlock]];
spinPath = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s05_result", "s05_result.wl"}];
libraryPath = FileNameJoin[{root, "common", "s06_result", "s06_result.wl"}];
spinMetadataPath=FileNameJoin[{root,channel,"s05_result","s05_metadata.wl"}];
spin = Get[spinMetadataPath]; library = Get[libraryPath];
gate["accepted real spin input", spin["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-real-response-v1" &&
  spin["Channel"] === channel && And @@ Values[spin["Checks"]]];
gate["accepted scalar reuse library", library["Schema"] === "polarized-sidis-scalar-library-v1" && And @@ Values[library["Checks"]]];
readLibrary[stage_] := Module[{row, path}, row = library["Library"][stage]; path = FileNameJoin[{root, row["File"]}];
  gate[stage <> " unchanged scalar input", IntegerString[FileHash[path, "SHA256"], 16, 64] === row["SHA256"]]; Get[path]];
geometryOriginal = readLibrary["s02"]; reductionOriginal = readLibrary["s04"];
gate["accepted geometry and reduction", geometryOriginal["Accepted"] && reductionOriginal["Accepted"]];
scalarConventionRules = {Q2 -> Q^2, w -> s23};
geometry = geometryOriginal /. scalarConventionRules;
reduction = reductionOriginal /. scalarConventionRules;
denominators = geometry["OnCutUncutPropagators"]; directions = geometry["UncutDirections"];
families = geometry["Families"]; familyNames = Keys[families];
commonBasis = geometry["BasisMomenta"];
commonCoordinates[value_] := Coefficient[Expand[value], #] & /@ commonBasis;
commonDot[left_, right_] := Factor[commonCoordinates[left].geometry["CommonGram"].commonCoordinates[right] /. geometry["CutRules"]];
momentumRules = {k2 -> First[geometry["LoopMomenta"]], k3 -> geometry["RecoilMomentum"] - First[geometry["LoopMomenta"]]};
gate["same cut momenta", And @@ (Expand[#] === 0 & /@ ((spin["CutMomenta"] /. momentumRules) - geometry["CutMomenta"]))];
gate["same positive-energy support", (spin["CutEnergySupport"] /. momentumRules) === geometry["CutEnergyConditions"]];
rows = spin["RealScalarProducts"]; oldValues = rows[[All, 3]];
targetValues = (commonDot[#[[1]] /. momentumRules, #[[2]] /. momentumRules] &) /@ rows;
globalSymbols[value_] := DeleteDuplicates[Cases[value, symbol_Symbol /; Context[symbol] === "Global`", Infinity]];
coordinateUnknowns = Complement[globalSymbols[oldValues], globalSymbols[geometry["CommonGram"]]];
coordinateSolutions = Solve[Thread[oldValues == targetValues], coordinateUnknowns];
gate["unique loop-coordinate conversion", Length[coordinateSolutions] === 1 && FreeQ[coordinateSolutions, _ConditionalExpression]];
coordinateRules = First[coordinateSolutions];
gate["all scalar products reconstruct", And @@ (zero /@ ((oldValues /. coordinateRules) - targetValues))];
gate["coordinate change preserves measured transverse constraint", FreeQ[spin["TransverseConstraint"], Alternatives @@ coordinateUnknowns]];

merge[pieces_List] := If[pieces === {}, <||>,
  Select[Merge[pieces, Factor[Together[Total[#]]] &], # =!= 0 &]];

(* All partial-fraction coefficients are solved from the actual affine
   propagators. No angular integral or phase-space formula is used. *)
decompose[powers_List] := decompose[powers] = Module[
  {support, relations, relation, constant, pieces, lowered},
  support = Flatten[Position[powers, _?(# > 0 &)]];
  If[support === {}, Return[<|powerKey @@ powers -> 1|>]];
  If[Length[support] <= 2 && MatrixRank[directions[[support]]] === Length[support],
    Return[<|powerKey @@ powers -> 1|>]];
  relations = NullSpace[Transpose[directions[[support]]]];
  relation = SelectFirst[relations, !zero[#.denominators[[support]]] &, $Failed];
  gate["nonzero affine relation for dependent propagators", relation =!= $Failed];
  constant = Factor[relation.denominators[[support]]];
  gate["relation constant is independent of loop coordinates", FreeQ[constant, a | b]];
  pieces = MapThread[Function[{position, coefficient},
    If[coefficient === 0, <||>,
      lowered = ReplacePart[powers, position -> powers[[position]] - 1];
      Map[Factor[coefficient #/constant] &, decompose[lowered]]]], {support, relation}];
  merge[pieces]];

extractAtoms[expression_] := Module[{rational, factors, powers, found, ratio, prefactor},
  rational = Together[expression];
  factors = Rest[FactorList[Denominator[rational]]];
  powers = ConstantArray[0, Length[denominators]];
  Do[If[!FreeQ[factor[[1]], a | b],
    found = SelectFirst[Range[Length[denominators]],
      Function[index, ratio = Cancel[factor[[1]]/denominators[[index]]];
        ratio =!= 0 && FreeQ[ratio, a | b]], Missing["UnknownPropagator"]];
    If[MissingQ[found], Print["UNKNOWN_PROPAGATOR ", InputForm[factor[[1]]]]];
    gate["every loop-dependent factor is a generated propagator", !MissingQ[found]];
    powers[[found]] += factor[[2]]], {factor, factors}];
  prefactor = Cancel[rational Times @@ MapThread[Power, {denominators, powers}]];
  gate["atom extraction leaves a polynomial numerator",
    FreeQ[Denominator[Together[prefactor]], a | b]];
  {powers, prefactor}];

familyRows[expression_, family_] := Module[
  {spec, transformed, numerator, denominator, denominatorPowers, denominatorCoefficient,
   polynomial, rows, reconstruction},
  spec = families[family];
  transformed = Together[expression /. spec["UncutCoordinateRules"]];
  numerator = Expand[Numerator[transformed]];
  denominator = Factor[Denominator[transformed]];
  gate["family numerator is polynomial", PolynomialQ[numerator, {v3, v4}]];
  denominatorPowers = Exponent[denominator, #] & /@ {v3, v4};
  denominatorCoefficient = Cancel[denominator/(Times @@ MapThread[Power,
    {{v3, v4}, denominatorPowers}])];
  gate["family denominator is a Laurent monomial", FreeQ[denominatorCoefficient, v3 | v4]];
  polynomial = CoefficientRules[numerator, {v3, v4}];
  rows = Association[Map[Function[entry,
    CutIntegral[family, Join[ConstantArray[1, Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]],
      denominatorPowers - First[entry]]] -> Factor[Last[entry]/denominatorCoefficient]], polynomial]];
  reconstruction = Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral, coefficient},
    coefficient Times @@ MapThread[Power, {{v3, v4}, -Drop[integral[[2]], 2]}]], rows]];
  gate["family Laurent coefficients reconstruct", zero[reconstruction - transformed]];
  rows];

mapExpression[expression_] := Module[{powers, prefactor, decomposition, pieces, rows, reconstruction},
  If[expression === 0, Return[<||>]];
  {powers, prefactor} = extractAtoms[expression];
  decomposition = decompose[powers];
  pieces = KeyValueMap[Function[{key, coefficient},
    Module[{indices = List @@ key, support, family, value},
      support = Flatten[Position[indices, _?(# > 0 &)]];
      family = SelectFirst[familyNames,
        Complement[support, families[#]["UncutIndices"]] === {} &, Missing["NoFamily"]];
      gate["every independent denominator set has a family", !MissingQ[family]];
      value = Cancel[prefactor coefficient/(Times @@ MapThread[Power, {denominators, indices}])];
      familyRows[value, family]]], decomposition];
  rows = merge[pieces];
  reconstruction = Total[KeyValueMap[Function[{integral, coefficient},
    coefficient Times @@ MapThread[Power,
      {families[integral[[1]]]["OnCutUncutPropagators"], -Drop[integral[[2]], 2]}]], rows]];
  gate["complete cut-family map reconstructs the input tensor", zero[reconstruction - expression]];
  gate["both physical cuts remain to unit power in every target",
    And @@ (Take[#[[2]], 2] === ConstantArray[1, Length[geometry["CutMomenta"]]] & /@ Keys[rows])];
  rows];

    name -> FileHash[FileNameJoin[{root, name}], "SHA256"]], compactConfig["files"]];
  compactIndices = compactConfig["component_indices"];
  compactExpected = Get[FileNameJoin[{cache, "component_" <> IntegerString[#, 10, 4] <> ".wl"}]] & /@ compactIndices;
  gate["own comparison accepted coefficient inputs", AllTrue[compactExpected,
    Lookup[#, "InputHash", None] === inputHash && TrueQ[#["ReconstructionPassed"]] && And @@ Values[#["Checks"]] &]];
  gate["own comparison includes nonzero and zero master coefficient blocks",
    AnyTrue[compactExpected, AnyTrue[Values[#["ReducedCoefficients"]], # =!= 0 &] &] &&
    AnyTrue[compactExpected, AllTrue[Values[#["ReducedCoefficients"]], # === 0 &] &]];
  compactControlInventory = MapThread[<|"Index" -> #1,
    "RawCheckCount" -> Length[rawTargetComponents[[#1]]["Checks"]],
    "RetainsTensorValue" -> KeyExistsQ[tasks[[#1]], "Value"],
    "MasterCount" -> Length[#2["ReducedCoefficients"]]|> &, {compactIndices, compactExpected}];
  Print["S08_COMPACT_CONTROL_INVENTORY ", InputForm[compactControlInventory]];
  compactProductionCache = cache;
  cache = FileNameJoin[{root, "cache", "s08_compact_worker", channel, Environment["JOB_ID"]}];
  gate["isolated compact comparison cache", cache =!= compactProductionCache && !DirectoryQ[cache]];
  CreateDirectory[cache, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True];
  Do[If[StringContainsQ[FileNameTake[name], "_master_"],
    CopyFile[FileNameJoin[{root, name}], FileNameJoin[{cache, FileNameTake[name]}]]],
    {name, Keys[compactConfig["files"]]}];
  gate["complete component outputs not copied", And @@ (!FileExistsQ[FileNameJoin[{cache,
    "component_" <> IntegerString[#, 10, 4] <> ".wl"}]] & /@ compactIndices)]];
slots = 2;
If[!IntegerQ[slots] || slots < 1, slots = 1]; CloseKernels[];
If[slots > 1, TimeConstrained[LaunchKernels[KernelConfiguration["localhost", "KernelCommand" ->
  "/home/physics/wolframengine/opt/Wolfram/WolframEngine/15.0/Executables/WolframKernel", "KernelCount" -> Min[2, slots], "TimeConstraint" -> 60]], 60, $Failed]];
workers = Length[Kernels[]];
If[workers > 0,
  gate["scalar-map workers share compute node", And @@ (SameQ[#, $MachineName] & /@ ParallelEvaluate[$MachineName])];
  ParallelEvaluate[$HistoryLength = 0; checks = <||>;
    $FeynCalcStartupMessages = False; Get["FeynCalc`"]];
  gate["scalar-map worker native versions agree", And @@ (SameQ[#, {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}] & /@
    ParallelEvaluate[{$Version, $FeynCalcVersion}])];
  compactDistributionStart = AbsoluteTime[];
  DistributeDefinitions[gate, bounded, put, putCompressed, zero, factoredDenominatorSum, cancelKnownDenominatorFactors,
    coefficientControl, controlTerms, controlValue, mapComponent, localReadRaw, localReducedComponent, root, localRawInputHash, tasks, cache, inputHash, inputHashes, mappingInputHashes,
    streamedDenominatorSum, cancelAvailableDenominatorFactors, streamProof, streamProofHash,
    localPolynomialTransfer, localExactPolynomialSum, localPolynomialBackendPath, localPolynomialBackendHash, localPolynomialProofHash,
    rawTargetComponents, sumValidation, sumFixture, channel, coordinateRules, ruleKeys, reduction, extendedReductionUsed,
    merge, decompose, extractAtoms, familyRows, mapExpression, denominators, directions, families, familyNames, geometry];
  compactDistributionSeconds = AbsoluteTime[] - compactDistributionStart;
  Print["S08_WORKER_DISTRIBUTION_SECONDS ", compactDistributionSeconds]];
$DistributedContexts = None;
If[compactValidationOnly,
  compactTaskHash = Hash[tasks, "SHA256"];
  gate["worker compact task identity", workers > 0 &&
    And @@ (# === compactTaskHash & /@ ParallelEvaluate[Hash[tasks, "SHA256"]])];
  compactComparison = AbsoluteTiming[If[workers > 0,
    ParallelMap[mapComponent, compactIndices, Method -> "FinestGrained"], mapComponent /@ compactIndices]];
  CloseKernels[];
  gate["own regenerated coefficient checks accepted", AllTrue[Last[compactComparison],
    AssociationQ[#] && AssociationQ[#["Checks"]] && And @@ Values[#["Checks"]] &]];
  gate["own complete mathematical coefficient records exactly unchanged",
    (KeyDrop[#, "Checks"] & /@ Last[compactComparison]) === (KeyDrop[#, "Checks"] & /@ compactExpected)];
  compactResult = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-compact-worker-input-validation-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
    "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes, "ControlFiles" -> compactFileHashes,
    "ComponentIndices" -> compactIndices, "ControlInventory" -> compactControlInventory,
    "OutputHashes" -> (Hash[#, "SHA256"] & /@ Last[compactComparison]),
    "ComparisonSeconds" -> First[compactComparison], "WorkerDistributionSeconds" -> compactDistributionSeconds,
    "InputFootprint" -> compactInputFootprint, "NativeVersions" -> {$Version, $FeynCalcVersion},
    "SourceHash" -> dispatchSourceHash, "BaselineSourceHash" -> FileHash[compactBaselinePath, "SHA256"],
    "ConfigHash" -> FileHash[compactConfigPath, "SHA256"], "Checks" -> checks|>;
  compactResultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, channel, "s08_compact_worker_result"}];
  If[!DirectoryQ[compactResultDir], CreateDirectory[compactResultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
  putCompressed[compactResult, FileNameJoin[{compactResultDir, "s08_result.wl"}]];
  Export[FileNameJoin[{compactResultDir, "s08_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
    "input_footprint" -> compactInputFootprint, "worker_distribution_seconds" -> compactDistributionSeconds,
    "comparison_seconds" -> First[compactComparison], "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"]|>, "RawJSON"];
  Print["PASS: s08_compact_worker_inputs"]; Quit[0]];
workerControl = First[If[workers > 0, ParallelMap[Function[unused, coefficientControl[]], {1}], {coefficientControl[]}]];
gate["production worker coefficient control accepted", AssociationQ[workerControl] && And @@ Values[workerControl["Checks"]]];
components = If[workers > 0, ParallelMap[localReducedComponent, Range[Length[tasks]], Method -> "FinestGrained"],
  localReducedComponent /@ Range[Length[tasks]]];
CloseKernels[];
gate["all scalar-map workers accepted", AllTrue[components, AssociationQ] && And @@ Flatten[Values[#["Checks"]] & /@ components]];
targets = Union[Flatten[Lookup[components,"RawTargets"]]];
gate["complete unchanged raw target inventory",targets===localMap["Targets"]];
missingTargets = Union[Flatten[Lookup[components, "MissingTargets"]]];
gate["all nonzero components mapped", Length[components] === Length[tasks] && And @@ Lookup[components, "ReconstructionPassed"]];
result = <|"Schema" -> "polarized-sidis-real-scalar-map-v1", "Channel" -> channel,
  "Components" -> components, "Targets" -> targets, "MissingTargets" -> missingTargets,
  "SavedMasterInventory" -> reduction["Masters"], "ReductionCoverageComplete" -> (missingTargets === {}),
  "ScalarConventionRules" -> scalarConventionRules, "CoordinateRules" -> coordinateRules,
  "Bookkeeping" -> bookkeeping, "PhotonLabels" -> spin["PhotonLabels"], "SpinLabels" -> spin["SpinLabels"],
  "IndexOrder" -> spin["IndexOrder"], "CutMomenta" -> geometry["CutMomenta"], "CutEnergySupport" -> geometry["CutEnergyConditions"],
  "TransverseSubstitution" -> spin["TransverseSubstitution"], "TransverseConstraint" -> spin["TransverseConstraint"],
  "Gamma5Scheme" -> spin["Gamma5Scheme"], "CouplingsRemoved" -> spin["CouplingsRemoved"],
  "CompactInputFootprint" -> compactInputFootprint,
  "ComponentStorage"->"reduced-coefficients-with-raw-file-references-v1",
  "NativeVersions"->{$Version,$FeynCalcVersion},"ImportedNativeVersions"->localImportedVersions,"ExecutionBackend"->"local",
  "SourceHash" -> sourceHash, "DispatchSourceHash" -> dispatchSourceHash,
  "StreamedNumeratorValidationHash" -> streamProofHash, "InputHash" -> inputHash, "InputHashes" -> inputHashes,
  "ExactPolynomialValidationHash"->localPolynomialProofHash,"ExactPolynomialAdapterHash"->FileHash[localPolynomialAdapterPath,"SHA256"],
  "ExactPolynomialBackendHash"->localPolynomialBackendHash,"ExactPolynomialBackendVersion"->"0.8.0",
  "RationalSumValidationHash" -> FileHash[sumValidationPath, "SHA256"], "WorkerCount" -> workers,
  "Checks" -> checks, "MappingAccepted" -> True, "MasterExpansionDepthChecked" -> False,
  "PhaseSpaceIntegrated" -> False, "FiniteNLOFHatsComputed" -> False, "PeakKernelMemoryBytes" -> MaxMemoryUsed[]|>;
resultDir = FileNameJoin[{root, "misc", "s10_result"}];
If[!DirectoryQ[resultDir], CreateDirectory[resultDir, CreateIntermediateDirectories -> True]];
putCompressed[result, FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s10_result.wl"}]];
Export[FileNameJoin[{resultDir, "s10_checks.json"}], <|"channel" -> channel, "checks" -> checks,
  "component_count" -> Length[components], "target_count" -> Length[targets], "missing_target_count" -> Length[missingTargets],
  "reduction_coverage_complete" -> (missingTargets === {}), "finite_nlo_fhats_computed" -> False,
  "job_id" -> Environment["JOB_ID"]|>, "RawJSON"];
Print["PASS: local Hgg master coefficients"]; Quit[0];

```

## Hgg/s11_result/reference/s05_factorize.wls

<!-- SOURCE {"anchor": "source-48", "appendix": "Hgg/README_sources.md", "bytes": 5738, "fence": "```", "kind": "file", "mode": 420, "path": "Hgg/s11_result/reference/s05_factorize.wls", "sha256": "389c5f18b1985345d179b55bf129ae68074b2c6cbbed5dbf87fdb797bccfc1a4"} -->
```wolfram
$HistoryLength=0;$FeynCalcStartupMessages=False;
Get["FeynCalc`"];
SetDirectory[DirectoryName[$InputFileName]];
If[!DirectoryQ["s05_result"],CreateDirectory["s05_result"]];
require[c_,m_] := If[!TrueQ[c],Print["FAIL: ",m];Quit[1]];
If[FileExistsQ["s05_result/Fhats.wl"],
  saved=Get["s05_result/Fhats.wl"];
  require[Values[saved["pole_residues"]]==={0,0} &&
    Values[Get["s04_result/endpoint_residues.wl"]]==={0,0},"saved result gates"];
  Print["PASS: final symbolic F1hat and F2hat saved; all pole and endpoint gates passed"];
  Quit[0]];
physical=Q2>0 && s>w>0 && w-Q2-s<t<-Q2 w/s;
kin=Get["s02_result/kinematics.wl"];u=kin["u"];
bornQ=Get["s02_result/born_qg.wl"];bornG=Get["s02_result/born_gq.wl"];
colorTrace=SUNSimplify[SUNTrace[SUNT[aa,aa]],SUNNToCACF->False] /. SUNN->Nc;
tf=Cancel[colorTrace/(Nc^2-1)];cf=Cancel[colorTrace/Nc];
require[FreeQ[{tf,cf},_SUNTrace|_SUNT|_SUNTF|_SUNDelta],"color normalization"];
pqg=2tf ((1-xi)^2+xi^2);pgq=2cf (1+(1-zz)^2)/zz; (* Eqs. 52-53 *)
initialS=xi(s+Q2)-Q2;initialT=t;initialU=xi u;
finalS=s;finalT=(t+Q2)/zz-Q2;finalU=u/zz;
initialMass=Expand[initialS+initialT+initialU+Q2];
finalMass=Together[finalS+finalT+finalU+Q2];
xiRoot=xi /. First[Solve[initialMass==0,xi]];
zzRoot=zz /. First[Solve[finalMass==0,zz]];
require[FullSimplify[0<xiRoot<1 && 0<zzRoot<1,physical],"factorization roots in support"];
xiJac=FullSimplify[Abs[D[initialMass,xi] /. xi->xiRoot],physical];
zzJac=FullSimplify[Abs[D[finalMass,zz] /. zz->zzRoot],physical];
flows={quark,antiquark}; (* Charge-conjugate Born tensors: Table II. *)
counter=Association@Table[projection -> Module[{initial,final},
  initial=(bornQ[projection] /. {s->initialS,t->initialT}) pqg/
    (xi If[projection=="pp",xi^2,1]);
  final=(bornG[projection] /. {s->finalS,t->finalT}) pgq/zz^2;
  Factor[Together[Total[Table[(initial /. xi->xiRoot)/xiJac+
    (final /. zz->zzRoot)/zzJac,{flow,flows}]]]]],{projection,{"g","pp"}}];
Put[<|"convolutions"->counter,"xi"->xiRoot,"zeta"->zzRoot,
  "jacobians"->{xiJac,zzJac},"TF"->tf,"CF"->cf,"flows"->flows|>,
  "s05_result/counterterms.wl"];

FCClearScalarProducts[];SPD[p]=0;SPD[q]=-Q2;SPD[p,q]=Q2/(2xh);
transverse=FVD[p,mu]-FVD[q,mu]SPD[p,q]/SPD[q];
tensor=(-MTD[mu,nu]+FVD[q,mu]FVD[q,nu]/SPD[q]) f1+
  transverse (transverse /. mu->nu) f2/SPD[p,q];
contractions={Contract[MTD[mu,nu]tensor],Contract[FVD[p,mu]FVD[p,nu]tensor]};
projectors=First[Solve[Thread[{Hg,Hpp}==contractions],{f1,f2}]];
require[FullSimplify[({f1,f2} /. projectors /. D->4-2eps)-{
  (-Hg/2+2xh^2 Hpp/Q2)/(1-eps),
  ((3-2eps)4xh^3 Hpp/Q2-xh Hg)/(1-eps)}] === {0,0},"paper projectors"];
Put[projectors,"s05_result/projectors.wl"];
Print["PASS: factorization support, Jacobians, and paper projectors"];
If[!FileExistsQ["s04_result/real.wl"],
  Print["Counterterms saved; rerun after angular integration finishes"];
  Quit[0]];
geometry=Get["s04_result/geometry.wl"];rhoSquare=geometry["rho_squared"];
reduceRoot[x_] := Module[{v=Together[x],n,d},
  n=PolynomialRemainder[Numerator[v],rho^2-rhoSquare,rho];
  d=PolynomialRemainder[Denominator[v],rho^2-rhoSquare,rho];
  Factor[n/d]];
compact[x_] := Module[{logs=DeleteDuplicates[Cases[x,_Log,Infinity]]},
  Collect[x,logs,reduceRoot]];
phase3=Pi w^-eps 2^-2 Pi^-eps Gamma[1-eps]/
  ((2Pi)^(6-2eps)Gamma[1-2eps]) mu2^(2eps); (* Eqs. 19, 38; angular Pi restored. *)
phaseCT=(2Pi)/(2Pi)^4 mu2^eps gs^2/(16Pi^2) (4Pi)^eps Exp[-EulerGamma eps]/eps;
realPhase=Normal[Series[phase3,{eps,0,1}]];
ctPhase=Normal[Series[eps phaseCT,{eps,0,1}]];
realParts=Table[
  output="s05_result/"<>FileNameTake[file];
  If[FileExistsQ[output],Get[output],
    Print["Combining ",FileNameTake[file]];
    part=Get[file];
    simple=Association@Table[projection -> {
      reduceRoot[part[projection][[1]]],
      compact[part[projection][[2]] /. Log[arg_] :> Log[reduceRoot[arg]]]},
      {projection,{"g","pp"}}];
    Put[simple,output];simple],
  {file,Sort[FileNames["real_*.wl","s04_result"]]}];
finite=<||>;poles=<||>;
Do[
  Print["Factorizing ",projection];
  realPole=reduceRoot[Total[#[projection][[1]]& /@ realParts]];
  realFinite=compact[Total[#[projection][[2]]& /@ realParts]];
  ct=Normal[Series[counter[projection] /. D->4-2eps,{eps,0,1}]];
  pole=reduceRoot[(realPhase /. eps->0) realPole+(ctPhase /. eps->0)(ct /. eps->0)];
  AssociateTo[poles,projection->pole];
  require[pole===0,projection<>" collinear pole cancellation"];
  AssociateTo[finite,projection->compact[(realPhase /. eps->0) realFinite+
    Coefficient[realPhase,eps]realPole+(ctPhase /. eps->0)Coefficient[ct,eps]+
    Coefficient[ctPhase,eps](ct /. eps->0)]];
  Print["PASS: ",projection," poles cancel"],{projection,{"g","pp"}}];
Put[poles,"s05_result/pole_residues.wl"];
hard=finite /. {gs->Sqrt[4Pi alphaS],eq->Sqrt[chargeSum]};
hats=AssociationThread[{"F1hat","F2hat"},compact /@ ({f1,f2} /. projectors /.
  {D->4,xh->Q2/(s+Q2),Hg->hard["g"],Hpp->hard["pp"]})];
require[FreeQ[hats,eps|ee|eq|gs|_Integrate|_Series|Indeterminate|ComplexInfinity],"finite symbolic F hats"];
mapS=Q2(1/xh-1);mapT=-Q2+zh(Q2-qT2);mapU=-zh Q2/xh;
maps={s->mapS,t->mapT,w->Factor[mapS+mapT+mapU+Q2]};
result=<|"channel"->"Hgg", "order"->HoldForm[alphaS^2],"Fhats"->hats,"contractions"->hard,
  "rho_squared"->rhoSquare,"rho_branch"->"positive","hat_variable_rules"->maps,
  "chargeSum"->"sum of squared electric charges of massless quark flavours",
  "mu2"->"common squared MSbar renormalization and factorization scale",
  "support"->HoldForm[Q2>0 && s>w>0 && w-Q2-s<t<-Q2 w/s],
  "delta"->{0,0},"plus"->{0,0},"pole_residues"->poles|>;
Put[result,"s05_result/Fhats.wl"];
Export["s05_result/Fhats.txt",ToString[result,InputForm,PageWidth->120],"Text"];
Print["PASS: final symbolic F1hat and F2hat saved; bytes ",ByteCount[hats]];
Quit[0];

```
